seams.name: World.buildTown + scripts/osm-to-town.js
seams.catches: unreachable or missing sites, roads drawn at the wrong width, buildings over roads, non-deterministic maps, converter cropping/projection errors
seams.misses: whether the map looks like the real town

seams.name: Sim.createGame / step / state / drainEvents
seams.catches: every gameplay rule: stones, police escort, crowd vs mob, arson, ally, leader, scrutiny, determinism

seams.name: Content (TOWNS, PARTY, RIVAL, LINES, fill)
seams.catches: missing or unfilled placeholders, wrong town metadata

seams.name: index.html in headless Chromium (playwright-core)
seams.catches: the menu-to-play journey, offline behaviour, keyboard focus, contrast, phone width, the scrutiny panel
seams.misses: gameplay rules (slow, so kept to the journey)

cases.title: converter crops, projects and keeps only tracked features
cases.given: test/fixtures/mini.osm: a 600 m square with one primary, one tertiary, one residential road, one footway, one building, one bus_station node, one place=quarter node and one node 2 km outside the crop
cases.when: osm-to-town converts it with a 500 m crop centred on the fixture
cases.then: the output has 3 roads with classes primary/tertiary/residential, no footway, 1 building, 1 landmark of kind bus_station, 1 place name, every point within 0..500 m, and source bounds plus attribution 'OpenStreetMap contributors'

cases.title: road classes are drawn at 3, 2 and 1 tiles
cases.given: the converted mini fixture
cases.when: World.buildTown builds it
cases.then: across the primary road the run of ROAD tiles is 3 wide, across the tertiary 2, across the residential 1, and no ROAD tile lies along the footway

cases.title: converter survives missing nodes and rejects non-OSM input
cases.given: test/fixtures/broken.osm: one residential way with 4 nd refs of which 1 node is missing, one way with only 1 known node; and a file containing '<html></html>'
cases.when: osm-to-town converts each
cases.then: the first way is kept with 3 points, the second is dropped, and the HTML file throws an Error whose message contains 'not an OSM export'

cases.title: Pulivendula map invariants and determinism
cases.given: data/towns/pulivendula.json
cases.when: World.buildTown builds it twice
cases.then: office, booth, start and blo exist, 5 doc shops and >= 3 stations exist, every site is reachable from start and not on a solid tile, office is > 0.5 * WORLD from start, no solid building covers a road tile, >= 80% of tiles under trunk/primary/secondary centre-lines are ROAD or BRIDGE, and both builds have identical tiles and sites

cases.title: bot completes both modes in Pulivendula
cases.given: createGame({ seed: 1, town: 'pulivendula', mode, police: false, goons: false, mobs: false }) for mode nomination and vote
cases.when: the route-following bot plays until the game ends
cases.then: both runs end with result.won === true

cases.title: pick Pulivendula and start Nomination Day offline
cases.given: npm run serve on a free port and a Chromium page that records every request
cases.when: the user selects Pulivendula in the town picker and presses Play
cases.then: the menu hides, the canvas draws frames, the HUD shows 'Pulivendula', there is no pincode input, and every request was to the local server

cases.title: Kadapa and Punganur invariants, real landmarks, bot
cases.given: data/towns/kadapa.json and data/towns/punganur.json
cases.when: World.buildTown builds each and the bot plays both modes with police, goons and mobs off
cases.then: each passes the T-3 invariants, Kadapa has a police station site within 3 tiles of the 1 Town Police Station point, each town has a bus stand within 3 tiles of its mapped bus station, labels include 'Kotapeta' (Punganur) and 'Nagarajupeta' (Kadapa), and all four bot runs win

cases.title: menu keyboard focus, contrast and disclaimer
cases.given: the menu at 1280x800
cases.when: the user presses Tab repeatedly from the page start
cases.then: focus reaches the town picker, both mode buttons and Play in that order, each focused element has a visible outline or box-shadow, every visible menu text node has >= 4.5:1 contrast against its background, and the disclaimer text equals the AC-4 sentence

cases.title: menu fits a 375 px phone
cases.given: the menu at 375x667
cases.when: the page loads
cases.then: document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth <= 375 and the Play button is fully inside the viewport width

cases.title: a stone hit tears papers, scatters supporters, stuns
cases.given: a nomination game in Pulivendula with papers 100, 4 supporters within 100 px of the candidate and a mob member 150 px away with clear line of sight
cases.when: the sim steps until the first 'stone' event that hits the candidate
cases.then: papers drop by exactly 10, at most 2 supporters leave and at least 1 does, and the candidate cannot move for 0.5 s (15 ticks)

cases.title: police escort a rioting mob
cases.given: a rioting mob and 3 cops within 260 px of it, the candidate with 5 supporters 200 px away
cases.when: the sim runs 3 s
cases.then: no mob member is ever detained or lathi-hit, and at least one cop is chasing the candidate or emits a lathi event against the crowd

cases.title: a crowd of 8 drives a mob back
cases.given: a mob 120 px from a candidate with 8 supporters around them, and the same setup with 7
cases.when: the sim runs 2 s
cases.then: with 8 the mob's distance to the candidate increases for 2 s; with 7 it does not

cases.title: replays stay deterministic with mobs and fires
cases.given: two games with seed 7, town kadapa, nomination mode, police, goons and mobs on
cases.when: both get the same scripted input for 900 ticks
cases.then: player position, papers, score, entity positions, fires and events are identical

cases.title: only supporters' houses and vehicles burn, fires block then free
cases.given: a mob walking past one supporter house, one parked vehicle and one ordinary house
cases.when: the sim runs until the mob has passed all three, then 20 s more
cases.then: the supporter house and the vehicle emit 'fire', the ordinary house never does, the footprint plus one ring of tiles is blocked while burning and walkable again after 20 s, with a 'burnt' event

cases.title: paths route around a burning street
cases.given: a flow field to the RO office whose shortest path passes a vehicle that is set on fire
cases.when: the field is rebuilt while the fire burns
cases.then: no step of the new path enters a blocked tile and the path is still found

cases.title: the ally joins, shields and shortens the hold
cases.given: a nomination game in Punganur with the candidate walking into the ally at the party office
cases.when: the ally joins and a stone then hits the candidate
cases.then: an 'ally' event fires, the crowd grows by 7 (ally plus 6), the stone costs exactly 5 points of papers, and the counter hold is the mode's hold minus 2 s

cases.title: leader leads the largest mob; every line fills
cases.given: each town's nomination game, and every string in Content.LINES and TOWNS filled with that town
cases.when: the sim runs 20 s, and fill runs on every string
cases.then: the entity with role 'leader' belongs to the largest mob, which is within 8 tiles of the RO office; no filled string contains '{' or '}'; leaders are Madhu Toogutla, Chaitanya and Bhupal

cases.title: scrutiny ends 10 filed, 6 torn, 4 accepted
cases.given: the bot completing Nomination Day in Pulivendula, and Polling Day in Pulivendula
cases.when: the counter hold finishes
cases.then: nomination emits exactly 6 'snatch' and 1 'tear' events, then ends with result.won true and result.scrutiny { filed: 10, torn: 6, accepted: 4 }; the vote run ends won with no scrutiny field and no snatch events

cases.title: the scrutiny panel shows the result, still under reduced motion
cases.given: the page with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and a won nomination result in Kadapa with scrutiny {10,6,4} handed to the result panel
cases.when: the panel opens
cases.then: it shows 'Kadapa', '10 YSRCP nominations filed', '6 snatched and torn' and '4 accepted', and no element in it has a running CSS animation or transition

cases.title: mode buttons expose their selected state
cases.given: the menu at 1280x800 with Nomination Day selected
cases.when: the user presses Tab to Polling Day and Space
cases.then: Polling Day has aria-pressed='true' (or aria-checked) and Nomination Day 'false', and the selected button shows a cue other than colour (e.g. a visible check mark or 'Selected' text)

cases.title: long messages wrap instead of squeezing
cases.given: the shared text-wrap helper used by toasts and bubbles, a measure function of 7 px per character, max width 230 px, and the longest filled LINES string for each town
cases.when: the helper wraps each string
cases.then: every line measures <= 230 px, no word is split unless longer than 230 px, and joining the lines with spaces gives back the original string

cases.title: scrutiny panel buttons reachable on short screens
cases.given: a won nomination result in Kadapa handed to the scrutiny panel at 667x375 and at 320x568
cases.when: the panel opens and the user presses Tab to the last button
cases.then: both 'Play again' and 'Back to menu' are fully inside the viewport when focused (the panel scrolls if needed) and nothing is clipped by overflow:hidden
